title: Three beliefs that waste a day of debugging

hotspots.label: Myth: the upload response proves the document is live.
hotspots.detail: An accepted upload is not yet a searchable document. Processing happens afterward, asynchronously.

hotspots.label: Myth: each kind of backlog is independent.
hotspots.detail: Documents, permissions, people data, and activity share one queue, so one backlog can delay another. The worst case runs from several hours to more than 24 hours.

hotspots.label: Myth: a correct-looking ACL is enough.
hotspots.detail: An ACL is still wrong if the identities it names were never pushed. An ACL naming a group Glean has never heard of matches nobody.
